adamrk opened PR #15074 from adamrk:abk/DirectDestination-update-remaining to bytecodealliance:main:

Fix a bug in DirectDestination which is used when writing to a host-provided buffer from a future or stream: The implementation of remaining for DirectDestination should return only the remaining part of the buffer (skipping what was already written to), but it always returned the full buffer. This allowed successive writes to overwrite previous ones.
